meta.notes: What a wind-resistant build changes, from published studies. Only figures with a source are used. The loss reduction applied in the app combines claim frequency and claim severity: 1 − (1 − frequency cut) × (1 − severity cut), at the low and high ends of the reported ranges. Applied to hurricane losses only; the study measured hurricane claims.

fortified_hurricane.basis: FORTIFIED homes vs conventionally built homes after Hurricane Sally (2020), claims from 88 insurers. University of Alabama Center for Risk and Insurance Research, 2025. Reported ranges differ between summaries; these span them.

above_code_bcr.basis: Building new homes to the IBHS FORTIFIED Home Hurricane standard: about $5 saved for every $1 spent (national, along the Gulf and Atlantic coasts). NIBS Natural Hazard Mitigation Saves, 2019.
